units.title: Basics of color reproduction
topics: 1.1. Different types of graphic originals and their characteristics, required physical and optical properties.
1.2. Fundamentals of light and color, color theories, human vision–rods & cones, metamerism and Adaptation, Attributes of color– hue, value, chroma.
uos: 1.c. Understand basic working of human eye.

units.title: Raster image processing
topics: 2.1. Raster image processing (RIP)- purpose, function, types, ideal and actual reflection of CMY process inks, proportionality failure, additivity failure,
2.2. Color correction tools such as under color removal (UCR), grey component replacement (GCR).
2.3. Study of color separation; color correction, screen angles, filters, spot colors, AM, FM & hybrid screening techniques.
uos: 2.a. Explain raster image processing and its function
2.c. Use color correction tools to save inks.

units.title: Image capturing devices
topics: 3.1. Flatbed scanners- working principle, components of scanner. Factors affecting scan quality, scanning resolution, bit depth of colour- definition and importance, 8 bit RGB.
3.2. Image capturing elements and their working principle, applications, advantages & disadvantages of PMT, CCD, CMOS. Digital Imaging and Colour Management Course Code: 4345805
uos: 3.b. Describe working of image capturing devices.

units.title: Data input and output methods
topics: 4.1. Pixel, resolution, bitmap (raster), vector RGB to CMYK.
4.2. Post script format, Page description language (PDL), PDF formats for printing industry, preflight-purpose, and workflow.
uos: 4.a. Understand digital workflow of file processing.

units.title: Color management
topics: 5.1. Cconcept, purpose, workflow (Device dependent and Device independent colors), advantages. color gamut - definition, color gamut of different processes.
5.2. International color consortium (ICC), Four C’s of color management, Test charts for different devices, Production of different color profiles.
5.3. Comparison of profiles, gamut mapping, is rendering intent, perceptual rendering indent, Relative & Absolute colourimetric intent, saturation intent. CIP4.
5.4. Ink saving by Colour profiles and colour gamut.
uos: 5.c. Use color gamut to understand limitation of different devices

units.title: Color Measurement
topics: 6.1. Physical colour specification systems such as munsell, pantone along with their working principle, advantages, applications and limitations. Standard observer 20 and 100
6.2. Working principle, advantages, applications & limitations of 3D i.e. solid color space such as CIE Lab, CIE LUV.

units.title: Quality Assurance
topics: 7.1. Spectrophotometer, colorimeter, densitometer - working principle, construction and applications.
7.2. Calculations based on DPI, PPI, LPI, resizing, file size, and colour deviation (Delta E), dot area, dot gain, trapping, hue error (simple numerical).
7.3. Maximum printable LPI for different printing processes, substrates and LPI relation. Digital Imaging and Colour Management Course Code: 4345805
uos: 7.a. Select screen angle for different jobs.
7.b. Describe construction of color measuring instruments.
